strings.『反撃』の機会を失わない為にも街を死守する方針を固めたナオ達の下に、シブヤにも粛: As Nao and the others make ready to hold the line in order to leave themselves a chance to counterattack, reports come in of Purgers entering Shibuya. Desperate to save the civilians in Shibuya, Nao comes up with a plan to use shifts in the Kaleidoscope to form a bridge. A diversionary force is sent to draw the enemy's attention.
strings.迷宮を繋げるのに必要な『星の神器』を借りる為にベルセティアを探して迷宮に赴いたナ: Nao enters the Kaleidoscope, seeking the Star Relic held by Belsidia to build a bridge. Leon comes to her rescue in the nick of time and finds he's brought along just the person she needs. Nao makes a concerned plea to Belsidia, convincing the woman to lend her aid in the task ahead.
strings.シブヤで避難誘導を行っていたセイジは、メムラムに避難所を任せて住民達を連れて地下: While evacuating the people of Shibuya, Seiji leaves Memram to protect their escape while he brings the group underground. Beginning with forces from the Silver Woods, a defensive battle spreads out above, while below, Seiji and the others witness Nao completing the bridge.
strings.倒しても続々と天から現れる粛清者達の姿に絶望を感じていたスイゼン達は、突如『下』: Despite numerous losses, the Purgers keep coming. Suizen's group begins to despair when suddenly, a dark energy bubbles up from below. Nao and the others believe it to be the power of the curse, but they bear witness to Challua and Regitare using the energy for an entirely different purpose.
strings.チャルアによって願いと形を与えられ街の各所に現れた残留思念達と、レシタールによる: Challua's power gives form to lingering emotions, making departed souls appear throughout the city. Regitare provides healing while sealing off the Purgers' power to reincarnate themselves. As Nao looks upon a city filled with those determined to fight on, the time comes to signal a counterattack.

strings.火のハニワとの激闘で得た絶品。エプロンをしたハニワから貰った、熱さを少しも感じさ: An exquisite piece won in a fierce battle with the Flashfire Hanifolk. A gift from a hani in an apron, these mysterious gloves keep out every bit of heat.
strings.火のハニワとの激闘で得た絶品。保存庫らしき場所にたくさん突き刺さっていた、凄まじ: An exquisite piece won in a fierce battle with the Flashfire Hanifolk. One of many found stuck in what looked like a storehouse, this sword gives off a fierce chill.
strings.火のハニワとの激闘で得た絶品。矢弾ではなく火薬を内蔵した棒を撃ち出す為に生み出さ: An exquisite piece won in a fierce battle with the Flashfire Hanifolk. This great bow was made to fire gunpowder-packed sticks instead of arrows.
strings.翠機兵の翼を流用して作られた絶品。内燃機関の稼働と空力学によって、焔風を纏う超熱: An exquisite piece made from recycled Gale Steambot wings. Its combustion engine and aerodynamic design let this mechanical axe deliver superheated slashes wreathed in blazing wind.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Gale Steambot wings. Its combustion engine and aerodynamic design let this mechanical axe deliver superheated slashes wreathed in blazing wind.
strings.蒼機兵の動力部の部品を流用して作られた絶品。魔核を中心に歯車仕掛が施され、変形に: An exquisite piece made from recycled Tidal Steambot engine parts. This necklace is built from gears around a magic core, and transforms to raise its output.
strings.閃機兵の蒸気管を流用して作られた絶品。蒸気圧で弾丸を更に加速させ、狙ったモノを蜂: An exquisite piece made from recycled Luminous Steambot steam pipes. This mechanical gun uses steam pressure to speed its bullets even further, riddling its target with holes.
strings.『星詠み』という組織が秘していた絶品。南に見える星の名を冠し、持ち主の雷の元素を: An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. The gun amplifies thunder magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern sky.
strings.『星詠み』という組織が秘していた絶品。南に見える星の名を冠し、持ち主の風の元素を: An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. The trident amplifies wind magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern sky.
strings.『星詠み』という組織が秘していた絶品。南に見える星の名を冠し、持ち主の闇の元素を: An exquisite piece that was sequestered away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. Named after a constellation in the southern sky, the otherworldly blade draws out the inner darkness lurking within its wielder.
strings.『星詠み』という組織が秘していた絶品。南に見える星の名を冠し、持ち主の火の元素を: An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. Bearing the name of a star in the southern sky, this whip draws out the fire within its wielder's soul.
strings.『星詠み』という組織が秘していた絶品。南に見える星の名を冠し、持ち主の水の元素を: An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. This bow amplifies water magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern night sky.
strings.『星詠み』という組織が秘していた絶品。南に見える星の名を冠し、持ち主の光の元素を: An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. The blade amplifies light magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern sky.
strings.守護者が護る遺跡から発掘された絶品。原理は不明だが、身に付けている間人の身を超え: An exquisite piece excavated from ruins under a guardian's watch. This gauntlet imbues its wielder with incredible physical strength, though the source of this empowerment remains a mystery.
strings.クラーケンの遺骸から仕立てた絶品。帝の名を冠する杖であり、海の支配者に相応しい力: An exquisite piece forged from the remains of a mighty kraken. Named after the emperor of the seas, only one who is fit to rule may lay claim to this staff.
strings.禍樹の樹液と枝から作った絶品。樹脂を磨き上げた刀身は疎らな刃紋を浮かべる: An exquisite piece created from the sap and branch of a wicked tree. The polished resin blade is decorated by wave-like patterns.
